paraphrase: The verse names together Viṣṇu, Puruṣa, Satya, Acyuta and Aniruddha (as the forms addressed in worship).
notes: Phase-B author read the passage in the local e-text (sources_raw/raw_etexts/mixed/gretil_devanAgarI/1_sanskr/4_rellit/vaisn/bhrgu-samhita.md (Vaikhānasa Bhṛgusaṃhitā, GRETIL)); level stays 'skeleton' until Phase C/D. The e-text reads 'aviruddhakam' for 'aniruddhakam' here; the same five recur at 22.134. The Kriyādhikāra places Puruṣa, Satya, Acyuta and Aniruddha in the eastern and other directions.
